title: APIZIT Linking manifest schema v1
description: Canonical authoring contract for APIZIT Linking schema v1 manifests. The compiler also recognizes a small, documented set of non-canonical migration forms.
$comment: This schema describes canonical manifests, not every migration form accepted and normalized by the compiler. Static validation by apizit-linking remains authoritative for module existence, Python signatures, path-source correspondence, and cross-route collisions.

version.description: Manifest schema version. It is independent from the apizit-linking package version.

runtime.description: Optional deployment runtime metadata. The standalone engine validates it but does not select infrastructure.

language.description: Runtime language supported by schema v1.

version.description: Requested Python minor version in major.minor form.

routes.description: HTTP routes linked to top-level Python functions.

pythonIdentifier.description: Portable, non-keyword Python identifier used by canonical manifests.

path.description: Absolute HTTP path without whitespace, query, or fragment. Placeholders use unique, non-keyword Python identifiers in braces.

method.description: Canonical uppercase HTTP method. The compiler normalizes case-insensitive migration input.

function.description: Portable dotted module:function reference. Python keywords and the reserved top-level apizit_linking module are not allowed.

parameters.description: Bindings keyed by an actual Python parameter name from the linked function signature.

name.description: Non-empty external request field name without leading, trailing, or line-break whitespace.
